name: ICP-pool-vegas-2026
observations: Target market: pool service companies in Las Vegas, Nevada
Ownership: independently owned only — no franchises
Company size: 5-25 employees
Must have active Google Business Profile
Google rating range: 3.5-4.5 stars (not perfect, not terrible)
Review count: 20+ reviews minimum
Time in business: 3+ years
Website status: exists but looks outdated or generic — major tell for opportunity
Marketing signal: owner is likely doing their own marketing (no agency, no in-house marketer)
Services they need: better website, consistent social content, Google Ads, review management
DISQUALIFY: franchises — Leslie's, Pinch A Penny, any chain
DISQUALIFY: companies with 5.0 rating AND 200+ reviews — they already have marketing dialed in
DISQUALIFY: companies with zero reviews — too small or too new to afford retainer
Pricing fit: $1,500-$2,000/month retainer (ad spend separate)
Pitch angle: Vegas-local, SonoView results as proof, done-for-you so owner can stop juggling marketing
